title: Catalogue titles
context: The content team wants a plain list of what's on the service.
task: Return title, genre and type for every show.
answer: SELECT title, genre, type FROM shows;

title: Movies only
context: The Movies tab lists only films.
task: Return title and duration_min for rows where type is 'Movie'.
answer: SELECT title, duration_min FROM shows WHERE type = 'Movie';

title: Kid-safe titles
context: Kids profiles only show TV-Y, TV-G and PG content.
task: Return title and maturity_rating for shows rated 'TV-Y', 'TV-G' or 'PG'.
answer: SELECT title, maturity_rating FROM shows WHERE maturity_rating IN ('TV-Y','TV-G','PG');

title: Long films
context: Which movies run over two hours?
task: Return title and duration_min for movies longer than 120 minutes.
answer: SELECT title, duration_min FROM shows WHERE type = 'Movie' AND duration_min > 120;

title: Recent releases
task: Return title and release_year for shows released in 2020 or later.
answer: SELECT title, release_year FROM shows WHERE release_year >= 2020;

title: Genres on the service
context: The genre filter needs one entry per genre.
task: Return the distinct genre values from shows.
answer: SELECT DISTINCT genre FROM shows;

title: Countries with subscribers
task: Return each distinct country from users.
answer: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM users;

title: Titles starting with 'The'
task: Return title for shows whose title starts with 'The '.
answer: SELECT title FROM shows WHERE title LIKE 'The %';

title: Currently open subscriptions
context: Subscriptions with no end date are still running.
task: Return subscription_id and user_id where end_date IS NULL.
answer: SELECT subscription_id, user_id FROM subscriptions WHERE end_date IS NULL;

title: Longest content first
task: Return title and duration_min ordered by duration_min descending.
answer: SELECT title, duration_min FROM shows ORDER BY duration_min DESC;

title: Oldest users
context: Loyalty program targets the earliest signups.
task: Return email and signup_date for the 5 earliest signups.
answer: SELECT email, signup_date FROM users ORDER BY signup_date LIMIT 5;

title: Three most-watched sessions
task: Return view_id, user_id and minutes_watched for the 3 longest sessions.
answer: SELECT view_id, user_id, minutes_watched FROM watch_history ORDER BY minutes_watched DESC LIMIT 3;

title: Hours watched per session
task: Return view_id and hours = minutes_watched / 60.0 rounded to 2 decimals.
hint: Divide by 60.0 to avoid integer division.
answer: SELECT view_id, ROUND(minutes_watched / 60.0, 2) AS hours FROM watch_history;

title: Annual plan value
context: What is each plan worth per year?
task: Return the distinct plan and yearly_price = monthly_price * 12 from subscriptions.
answer: SELECT DISTINCT plan, monthly_price * 12 AS yearly_price FROM subscriptions;

title: Email domains
context: Which mail providers do users use?
task: Return user_id and domain = the part of email after '@'.
answer: SELECT user_id, SUBSTR(email, INSTR(email, '@') + 1) AS domain FROM users;

title: Shouty titles
context: Marketing wants title text in caps for banners.
task: Return UPPER(title) as banner for every show.
answer: SELECT UPPER(title) AS banner FROM shows;

title: How many series vs movies?
task: Return type and title_count for each type.
answer: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS title_count FROM shows GROUP BY type;

title: Sessions on TV
context: How much viewing happens on the big screen?
task: Return tv_sessions = number of watch_history rows with device 'TV'.
answer: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tv_sessions FROM watch_history WHERE device = 'TV';

title: Distinct viewers
context: How many users have watched anything at all?
task: Return viewers = COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) from watch_history.
answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS viewers FROM watch_history;

title: Total minutes streamed
task: Return total_minutes = SUM(minutes_watched) across all sessions.
answer: SELECT SUM(minutes_watched) AS total_minutes FROM watch_history;

title: Average session length
context: How long does a typical sitting last?
task: Return avg_minutes = average minutes_watched rounded to 1 decimal.
answer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(minutes_watched), 1) AS avg_minutes FROM watch_history;

title: Average runtime by type
task: Return type and avg_duration (1 decimal) from shows grouped by type.
answer: SELECT type, ROUND(AVG(duration_min), 1) AS avg_duration FROM shows GROUP BY type;

title: Release span
task: Return oldest and newest = MIN and MAX of release_year.
answer: SELECT MIN(release_year) AS oldest, MAX(release_year) AS newest FROM shows;

title: Titles per genre
task: Return genre and title_count for each genre.
answer: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS title_count FROM shows GROUP BY genre;

title: Users per plan
task: Return plan and user_count from users grouped by plan.
answer: SELECT plan, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM users GROUP BY plan;

title: Sessions per device
context: Device mix for the product team.
task: Return device and sessions count, ordered by sessions descending (ties by device).
hint: GROUP BY device ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC.
answer: SELECT device, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM watch_history GROUP BY device ORDER BY sessions DESC, device;

title: Minutes per user
task: Return user_id and total_minutes = SUM(minutes_watched) per user.
answer: SELECT user_id, SUM(minutes_watched) AS total_minutes FROM watch_history GROUP BY user_id;

title: Top 5 most-watched shows by minutes
context: The 'Trending' row is driven by minutes.
task: Return show_id and minutes = SUM(minutes_watched), top 5 by minutes descending (ties by show_id).
hint: GROUP BY, ORDER BY DESC, LIMIT 5.
answer: SELECT show_id, SUM(minutes_watched) AS minutes FROM watch_history GROUP BY show_id ORDER BY minutes DESC, show_id LIMIT 5;

title: Heavy viewers
task: Return user_id and sessions for users with more than 10 rows in watch_history.
answer: SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM watch_history GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;

title: Who watched what
task: Return user_id, title and minutes_watched for every session.
answer: SELECT w.user_id, s.title, w.minutes_watched FROM watch_history w JOIN shows s ON s.show_id = w.show_id;

title: Thriller sessions
task: Return view_id, title and minutes_watched for sessions on shows in the 'Thriller' genre.
answer: SELECT w.view_id, s.title, w.minutes_watched FROM watch_history w JOIN shows s ON s.show_id = w.show_id WHERE s.genre = 'Thriller';

title: Minutes per genre
context: Which genres capture the most viewing time?
task: Return genre and minutes = SUM(minutes_watched) per genre.
answer: SELECT s.genre, SUM(w.minutes_watched) AS minutes FROM watch_history w JOIN shows s ON s.show_id = w.show_id GROUP BY s.genre;

title: Session length bucket
task: Return view_id and bucket: 'Long' if minutes_watched >= 60, 'Medium' if >= 25, else 'Short'.
answer: SELECT view_id, CASE WHEN minutes_watched >= 60 THEN 'Long' WHEN minutes_watched >= 25 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Short' END AS bucket FROM watch_history;

title: Signups per year
task: Return signup_year (integer) and signups count from users.
answer: SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', signup_date) AS INTEGER) AS signup_year, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM users GROUP BY signup_year;
